pages.text: Meteors land on dry ground, never in lakes or the sea. They sit about half buried in a wide crater: levelled ground, a raised rim and a scatter of gravel, tuff and coarse dirt. They're big (55 to 78 blocks across the middle) and about 550 blocks apart on average.
pages.title: Finding a Meteor

pages.text: Look for the crater rim from a hill, or the pale shell rising out of the ground. The shell is $(l:basics/stones)Shellrock$(/l): nothing but a $(l:basics/crustbreaker)Crustbreaker$(/l) can mine it, and explosions don't touch it.$(br2)Ops can find the nearest one with $(thing)/locate structure exofall:swamp_meteor$() (or hive, desert, rainforest).
